app.name: Screen Organizer
app.subtitle: for iOS
editor.noDevices: No devices. Connect an iPhone or iPad with a cable and unlock it.
editor.readOnly: Read-only mode: device writes are disabled.
editor.readOnlyNotice: Read-only mode: device writes are disabled. Draft changes stay on this Mac.
editor.connectHint: Connect your iPhone or iPad with a cable, unlock it and tap Trust if asked. Read its Home Screen, then edit the local draft. Apply writes the layout to the device.
editor.bankHint: Park apps, folders or widgets here while you rearrange. Empty it before applying.
editor.bankEmpty: Drag items here to set them aside.
editor.libraryHint: Apps here are off your Home Screen but still installed. Drag apps in or out.
editor.libraryUnavailable: This device doesn’t expose the App Library.
editor.libraryEmpty: Drag apps here to keep them only in the App Library.
editor.closeGapsHint: Let these flow with the rest again (closes their gaps)
editor.widgetGridHint: iPad widgets don’t map exactly onto the icon grid; this page keeps the shape iPadOS gave it.
editor.insertPage: Insert a page after this one
editor.deletePageHint: Delete page (apps go to the App Library)
editor.deletePageBody: Its apps, including those in folders, move to the App Library. They stay installed.
editor.dropExact: Drop here to place an app exactly in this spot
editor.newPageHint: Drop apps here to put them on a new page
editor.onlyAppsInLibrary: Only apps can go to the App Library
editor.draftKept: Your changes are kept as this device’s draft
editor.readAgainBody: This replaces your unapplied changes with what’s on the {device} now.
editor.gapsWarning: iOS doesn’t report empty spaces or hidden pages over USB. Gaps made on the {device} itself will close.
editor.placedItemsKept: Items placed here keep their spots: {count}.
editor.keepGapHint: To keep a gap, place the app in that spot here.
editor.applyBackupHint: Your current layout is backed up first. After writing, the app reads the {device} again to check the result.
editor.resultMismatch: The {device} doesn’t match the plan exactly. Details:
editor.backupSaved: Backup saved as {backup}. You can restore it from Backups.
editor.hiddenClipsBody: Everything else landed as planned. iOS also placed {count} previously unreported web clips in free spots on the {device}:
editor.hiddenClipsHint: Screen Organizer knows about them now. Send them to the App Library, or arrange them on the Home Screen like any app.
editor.clipsInLibrary: Web clips are in the App Library
editor.noBackups: No backups yet. One is saved before every apply and restore.
editor.restoreBody: This writes that layout to your {device}. Your current layout is backed up first.
editor.groupBody: Look up categories using Apple’s public App Store API. Only bundle IDs are sent; results are cached on this Mac. Only Home Screen apps outside folders with a known App Store category move into folders named for their category. Existing folders with the same name are reused.
editor.removeFolderBody: Its apps go back to where the folder was.
editor.resetBody: Go back to the layout as read from the {device}. You can undo this.
editor.authenticationFailed: Could not authenticate. Reopen Screen Organizer from its launcher.
editor.usageHint: See which apps get used and how many page swipes your layout costs. Read the {device}’s memory reports, or Screen Time synced to this Mac.
editor.usageMacHint: Needs Screen Time › Share Across Devices, and Full Disk Access for this app
editor.usageReports: From {reports} memory reports on the {device} over {days} days. Estimated page swipes:
editor.usageScreenTime: Estimated page swipes, last {days} days of Screen Time
editor.backgroundApps: Counted less, since iOS also runs them in the background: {apps}
editor.helpApplyHint: Edits stay in the local draft. Apply writes the layout to the device. Apps in the App Library stay there.
editor.help.dragBody: Drop on another icon’s left or right edge to place it there.
editor.help.swapTitle: Hold ⌥ Option while dropping on an icon
editor.help.gapBody: Place it exactly there, leaving gaps. A blue dot marks a placed item.
editor.help.selectBody: Select several, then choose New folder or To App Library.
editor.help.deleteBody: Send selected apps to the App Library.
editor.help.bankBody: Park items while rearranging; empty the bank before applying.
editor.help.undoBody: Undo or redo as far back as you like.
editor.help.searchBody: Search: matches are outlined and the rest dimmed.
editor.help.usageBody: Read device memory reports or Screen Time, then choose Organize › Optimize by app usage. Usage optimization includes page 1 and sorts folder contents, including folders in the Dock.
editor.help.reviewBody: Back up the device’s layout, write your draft, then read it back to check.
native.engineMissing: The engine is missing from the app bundle ({path}).
native.authenticationFailed: The local server failed authentication. Restart Screen Organizer to try again.
native.engineTimeout: The engine didn’t start within a minute.
mcp.title: MCP Setup
mcp.intro: Connect Codex or Claude Code to read layouts and edit drafts with Screen Organizer.
mcp.lifecycle: Your client starts the local stdio engine when it connects.
mcp.applyMode: Allow applying layouts to the device
mcp.updateCodex: Update Codex CLI to register this server, or copy its configuration from Advanced.
mcp.remoteConflict: Rename the remote server in Claude Code before registering this local server.
mcp.cleanupPending: Refresh status to finish cleaning up the registration record.
mcp.recoveryConflict: The registration changed during recovery. Review the entry in your client.
mcp.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy. Select and copy the text.
mcp.browserSetup: Run the setup command in Terminal, then refresh your client’s MCP tools.
mcp.timeout: The client command timed out. Try again.
consent.title: Before you begin
consent.readToEnd: Read to the end to continue.
consent.affiliation: Screen Organizer is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Apple Inc.
consent.trademarks: Mac, macOS, iPhone, iPad and Screen Time are trademarks of Apple Inc. IOS is a trademark or registered trademark of Cisco in the U.S. and other countries and is used by Apple under license.
consent.deviceInterfaces: This tool uses private device interfaces that may change with iOS updates.
consent.backups: A Home Screen layout backup is saved before applying or restoring a layout. The app attempts to verify the result by reading the layout back. Keep a separate, up-to-date full backup of your iPhone or iPad.
consent.warranty: Use the tool at your own risk. It is provided “AS IS” under the MIT License, without warranty of any kind.
consent.clientData: Connected MCP clients can read device layouts and app information exposed by this server. Their handling of that data follows the client’s settings and policies. Review those settings before connecting.
consent.declined: Agreement declined. Close this tab to exit.
mcp.sourceHint: Use the installed home-screen-mcp executable. If your client cannot find it, replace home-screen-mcp with its absolute path in each example.
validation.bank: App Bank contains {count} items. Place them or send them to App Library.
validation.emptyPage: Page {page} is empty. Remove empty pages before applying.
validation.pin: Page {page}: {name} cannot be placed at row {row}, column {column}.
validation.folderCapacity: Folder “{name}”, page {page}, contains {count} items; capacity is {capacity}.
validation.folderContents: Folder “{name}” contains a folder or widget. Move it out before applying.
validation.unknown: The draft has a layout problem. Review the details.
error.operation: The operation could not be completed.
error.readAgain: Read the device again before continuing.
error.busy: Another operation is running. Wait for it to finish.
error.widgetsDock: Widgets cannot be placed in the Dock.
error.folderItem: Folders and widgets cannot be placed inside a folder.
error.moveWidgets: Move or remove the widgets on this page first.
error.writeFormat: Use ordinary page order with this write format.
error.position: This position is unavailable. Choose another spot.
error.backup: This backup cannot be restored. Review its details.
error.ios16: This iOS version requires ordinary page order for these items.
error.usageSync: No synced Screen Time data. Turn on Screen Time › Share Across Devices on your iPhone and Mac using the same Apple Account.
error.usageAccess: macOS blocked Screen Time data access. Give the app or terminal Full Disk Access in System Settings › Privacy & Security.
error.usageDays: No Screen Time data from this iPhone in the last {days} days.
error.usageReports: This device has no memory reports yet. Try again after a few days of use, or use Screen Time.
error.usageSource: This source cannot report app usage.
mcp.modeHint: The selected mode is used for registration and copied configuration. Existing registrations change only when you update them.
mcp.serviceError: The engine did not complete initialization and tool discovery. Review the diagnostics and try again.
mcp.notExecutable: The selected file cannot be executed. Choose the client executable.
mcp.snapshotFailed: The existing configuration could not be saved for recovery. No replacement was attempted.
mcp.recoveryFailed: The previous configuration could not be restored. Review the client configuration before retrying.
mcp.invalidResponse: The client returned an unrecognized configuration response. Refresh status or review the client configuration.
mcp.operationFailed: The client operation failed. Review the diagnostics and try again.
error.pinIdentifier: This item has no known placement identifier. Use ordinary page order for it.
error.backupGrid: This backup lacks valid saved grid dimensions. Use a backup that includes its original grid.
error.savedPosition: Saved positions do not fit this layout or grid. Choose compatible positions or another backup.
editor.resultUnknown: Verification could not finish. Read the device again before making another change.
error.ambiguousIdentifier: Multiple items share this placement identifier. Use ordinary page order for them.
error.staleDraft: Another session changed the saved draft. Reopen it or read the device again.
error.keepPage: Keep a Home Screen page to preserve the grid dimensions.
error.wireConflict: Different apps share a display identifier in this USB layout. The device cannot distinguish them.
